goal:
Make the price a painter sees the most they can pay, and give credits a single owner. Spec: docs/payments/2026-11-01-paid-board-revision-spec.md §C2; docs/implementation/2026-11-01-wall-split-spec.md (known bugs).

SCOPE
- Pass max_credits = the quoted stroke total to draw and draw_many.
- On PriceRoseAboveMax: re-quote and ask the painter once, showing the new total.
- pricing-controller holds the only balance: queued paints reserve their credits (pending debits), released on failure, settled from the chain on success.
- Invalidate cellCostCache entries when the board update touches those cells.

ACCEPTANCE
- Test (fails on main): five queued taps with 2 credits -> only two are sent.
- Test: a stroke quoted at 3 sends max_credits 3; PriceRoseAboveMax shows the re-quote.
- Test: a cell repainted by someone else is re-priced, not served from cache.

BEFORE YOU START
Read AGENT.md, docs/learning/traps.md and the spec section named above. Contract changes were approved by the owner on 1 Nov for this revision only, on testnet. Do not deploy to mainnet.

DONE MEANS
AGENT.md's definition of done: tests named that fail before and pass after, cargo test / npm test / npm run build as relevant, a '## Learned' line in the PR, and the backlog row's new status written in the PR description (the merger updates docs/backlog.md on main; see AGENT.md).
